sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Employees Social Security Sindh Amendment Act 1973
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XIII OF 1973
ACT XIII OF 1973
WEST PAKISTAN
EMPLOYEE'S SOCIAL SECURITY (SIND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1973
An Act to amend
the West Pakistan Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965, in its
application to the Province of Sind
[Gazette of Sind,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 4th July 1973]
(First published after having
received the assent of the President of Pakistan in the Gazette of Sind
(Extraordinary) dated 4th July 1973).
No. PAS/Legis-B-2/73.--The
West Pakistan Employees' Social Security (Sine Amendment) Bill, 1973 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sind on the 5th June 1973, and assented to
by the President of Pakistan on the 4th July 1973, is hereby published as an
Act, of the Legislature of Sind :-
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the West Pakistan Employees'
Social Security (Sine Amendment) Act, 1973.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Employees Social Security Sindh Amendment Act 1973
sections.description:
Amendment of section 5 of West Pakistan Ordinance X of 1965

ACT XIII OF 1973
ACT XIII OF 1973
WEST PAKISTAN
EMPLOYEE'S SOCIAL SECURITY (SIND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1973
An Act to amend
the West Pakistan Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965, in its
application to the Province of Sind
[Gazette of Sind,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 4th July 1973]
(First published after having
received the assent of the President of Pakistan in the Gazette of Sind
(Extraordinary) dated 4th July 1973).
No. PAS/Legis-B-2/73.--The
West Pakistan Employees' Social Security (Sine Amendment) Bill, 1973 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sind on the 5th June 1973, and assented to
by the President of Pakistan on the 4th July 1973, is hereby published as an
Act, of the Legislature of Sind :-
2. Amendment of section 5 of
West Pakistan Ordinance X of 1965.---In the West Pakistan Employees' Social
Security Ordinance, 1965, in its application to the Province of Sind, in
section 5, in subsection (1) :-
(i) far clause
(a), the following shall be substituted, namely:-
"(a) a
person who is a Minister of the Province or who is or has been a Judge of the
High Court or a Senior Officer In the service of Pakistan not below the rank of
a Commissioner of a Division or Joint Secretary to the Central Government or
Secretary to Government, and such person shall be the Chairman of the Governing
Body;"; and
(ii) for clause
(e), the following clauses shall be substituted, namely :-
(e) the
Commissioner;
(f) the Medical
Adviser, ex office ; and
(iii) in
subsection (1) of section 12, clause (d) shall be omitted.
